abstract: Teratomas of the head and neck are rare, benign neoplasms, usually presenting in the neonatal period and are often malignant with regard to their location. Teratomas occur with a frequency of one in 4,000 live births with head and neck teratomas accounting for <5% of the total. Extensive literature search has shown that there are only two cases congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma reported in India, and we report the third such case.
abstract_ja: 頭頸部の奇形腫は稀な腫瘍であり、通常は新生児期に発症する。局在のため悪性の経過をたどることが多い。奇形腫は出生4,000例に1例の頻度で発生し、頭頸部奇形腫は全体の5%未満を占める。文献検索の結果、インドで報告された先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫は2例のみであり、本報告は3例目である。
